Soak 240 g of kabuli chana overnight and boil.

Serve hot, garnished with juliennes of ginger and coriander leaves.

Chicken Biryani Recipe:
Soak 250 g basmati rice for 30 minutes. Cook the rice,
drain the excess water, and keep aside.
Marinate 250 g chicken with 50 g curd, salt as per taste,
and 1 tsp Catch Chicken Biryani Masala. Keep aside for 15 minutes.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a thick-bottom pan. Fry 3 sliced
onions until golden brown. Remove half for layering. Add 1 tbsp Catch Ginger
Garlic Paste and sauté well.
Add the puree of 1 tomato and cook until the oil
separates. Add 1/2 tsp Catch Turmeric and 1/2 tsp Catch Red Chilli Powder.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until the chicken is
almost done. Add water as required and cook until the oil separates.
Add 2 tsp Catch Chicken Biryani Masala and cook for 1
minute.
Grease the pan. Arrange alternate layers of cooked rice
and cooked chicken. Spread butter, chopped mint, fried onions, and rose water
between the layers and on top.
Add 5 tbsp milk. Cover the pan with a lid, seal the edges
with thick dough or wrap with aluminium foil, and cook on a low flame for 12 to
15 minutes.
Open the lid, mix gently, garnish with green coriander
leaves, and serve hot.

details.description: Catch Dal Tadka Masala is one of its own kind in the market. This Indian spice adds a tadka and savoury aroma to the arhar dal or mix dal. details.usageInstructions:
Dal Tadka Recipe:
Clean and wash 200 gm Tur Dal (Arhar dal)/Mix Dal. Add 8 cups (1200ml) water, 1⁄2 tsp Catch Turmeric Powder, salt as per taste and pressure cook. After one whistle, keep on low flame for 8-10 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp desi ghee or oil in a pan or 'kadhai', now add 1 tsp Catch Cumin Seeds and let them crackle.
Add 1⁄2 tsp Catch Hing and cook for a few seconds, now add 1 tsp chopped garlic, 1 tsp chopped ginger and add 1⁄2 tsp green chillis and cook for 2 minutes.
Now add 2 medium size finely chopped onions and cook for 3 minutes after this add 2 medium-sized chopped tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes on medium flame.
Now add 2 tsp 'Dal Tadka Masala' and cook for 2 minutes on low flame then add 100ml water and cook for 2 minutes.
Add boiled dal and mix well. Let it simmer for 3 minutes on a low flame.
Garnish with freshly chopped coriander leaves and 1 tsp of desi ghee and serve hot with rice/roti.
Storage:
Keep in a clean, cool and dry place away from sunlight.
Once opened, store the contents in an airtight container.
